q: How do I create an account on TechSchool?
a: Click the 'Sign Up' button on the homepage and fill in your details like name, email, and password.

q: What are the password requirements?
a: Your password must be at least 8 characters long and include a mix of letters, numbers, and special characters.

q: I forgot my password. What should I do?
a: Click on 'Forgot Password' on the login page. Enter your email to receive an OTP for resetting your password.

q: How do I change my password?
a: Log in to your account, go to the Profile Settings, and select 'Change Password.'

q: What should I do if I don't receive the OTP?
a: Check your spam/junk folder. If it's not there, try resending the OTP or contact support.

q: Can I update my email address?
a: Yes, go to Profile Settings and select 'Update Email.'

q: How do I find tutorials for a specific skill?
a: Use the search bar or browse by categories like CSE Basics, Coding, or Development.

q: How do I select the best tutorial?
a: Check the ratings and reviews provided by other learners to make an informed choice.

q: Can I watch tutorials offline?
a: Currently, tutorials are only available online.

q: Are there free tutorials available?
a: Yes, all tutorials are free.

q: How do I download notes or cheatsheets?
a: Go to the Notes section, select the material you want, and click the 'Download' button.

q: Are the notes handwritten or typed?
a: The notes are handwritten and available in PDF format.

q: What are cheatsheets?
a: Cheatsheets are concise summaries designed for quick revision.

q: Do I need a premium account to download notes?
a: No, all the notes are free you can download by normal Account.

q: Can I share downloaded notes with others?
a: Notes are for personal use only; sharing them violates our terms of service.

q: What types of quizzes are available?
a: We offer quizzes in CSE Basics, Coding, and Development.

q: How do I start a quiz?
a: Go to the Quiz section, select your desired topic, and click 'Start Quiz.'

q: Can I review my quiz answers?
a: Yes, your answers and explanations for correct answers are displayed after submission.

q: Are the quizzes timed?
a: Yes, each quiz has a time limit, which is displayed before you start.

q: Can I retake a quiz?
a: Yes, quizzes can be retaken to improve your score.

q: How are quiz results displayed?
a: Results are displayed instantly after you submit your answers.

q: What does my performance summary include?
a: It includes your score, time taken, and areas for improvement.

q: Can I track my progress over time?
a: Yes, your profile dashboard shows your progress and past quiz results.

q: Are quiz scores shared publicly?
a: No, your scores are private and visible only to you.

q: Can I download my performance report?
a: Currently, performance reports are viewable online only.

q: How can I reset my password?
a: To reset your password, go to the 'Forgot Password' section on the login page, enter your email, and follow the instructions sent to your inbox.

q: How do I delete my account?
a: To delete your account, please contact our support team at support@example.com with a request to delete your account. Please note, this action is permanent.

q: How can I update my profile?
a: To update your profile, log in to your account and go to the 'Profile' section where you can update your personal information and preferences.

q: What types of tutorials do you offer?
a: We offer a wide variety of tutorials, including coding, development, and computer science basics. You can find these tutorials in the 'Tutorials' section of the website.

q: Do you have a mobile app?
a: Currently, we do not offer a mobile app, but our website is fully optimized for mobile devices and tablets.

q: How do I give feedback on a tutorial?
a: You can leave feedback on any tutorial by navigating to the tutorial page and using the rating and review system at the bottom of the page.

q: Can I download tutorials?
a: Yes, you can download PDF versions of the tutorials, notes, and cheatsheets from the 'Download' section on each tutorial page.

q: Is there a subscription fee?
a: No, all the tutorials and quizzes on TechSchool are free. You only need an account to track your progress and save your work.

q: How can I contact customer support?
a: You can reach our customer support team by emailing us at support@example.com. We aim to respond within 24 hours.

q: How can I join your community?
a: You can join our community by creating an account and participating in forums and discussion boards available to all users.
